title: Underwriting Eligibility Chart by Manufactured Home Insurance Form
content:
Each Manufactured Home Insurance form has its own entry gate on the home and its own roof-age and claims standards.

## Entry gate

| Policy form | Oldest home accepted (home age) | Tie-downs present | Paid claims in the last 3 years |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | 40 years | Required | No gate |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | 25 years | Required | No gate |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | 40 years | Required | No gate |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | 25 years | Required | No gate |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | 20 years | Required | No gate |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | 15 years | Required | Must be 0 |

On every form the home must be anchored with tie-downs meeting the community's wind-zone standard.

## Roof age and claims standards

| Policy form | Oldest roof accepted | Paid claims within the claims lookback at which the carrier non-renews | Claims lookback |
|---|---|---|---|
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value | 30 years | 3 | 3 years |
| Manufactured Home Basic Form - Replacement Cost | 15 years | 3 | 3 years |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value | 30 years | 3 | 3 years |
| Manufactured Home Broad Form - Replacement Cost | 15 years | 3 | 3 years |
| Manufactured Home Special Form - Replacement Cost | 20 years | 2 | 3 years |
| Manufactured Home Special Form Plus - Extended Replacement Cost | 20 years | 2 | 3 years |

The oldest roof accepted is stated in years; on the replacement-cost forms a roof older than that figure is settled at actual cash value.

## Reading the chart (hypothetical homes)

| Home age | Forms whose home-age gate it meets |
|---|---|
| 15 years | All six forms |
| 16 years | Every form except the Special Form Plus |
| 20 years | Every form except the Special Form Plus |
| 21 years | The two Basic forms and the two Broad forms |
| 25 years | The two Basic forms and the two Broad forms |
| 26 years | Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value and Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value |
| 40 years | Manufactured Home Basic Form - Actual Cash Value and Manufactured Home Broad Form - Actual Cash Value |

A home with one paid claim in the last 3 years does not meet the Special Form Plus entry gate, whatever its age. Two paid claims within the 3-year lookback reach the non-renewal count on the two Special forms; on the Basic and Broad forms the count is reached at 3.
